analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($529.76) vs SMA5/20/50 ($522.91/$506.62/$495.84): trading above short-term and mid-term SMAs, indicating bullish bias.
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($446.77/$432.24): maintaining strong mid-to-long-term uptrend.
· 52-week position (88.3%) + approaching historical high price levels.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (60.4→68.2): entering overbought territory, confirming sustained upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0753→1.6382): continuous improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper Band $530.41): approaching the upper band, suggesting potential for further upside.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($517.55): based on EMA20, expected to act as a defense line during short-term pullbacks.
· Swing resistance ($531.03): nearing 52-week high, potential for trend strengthening upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low pattern (Higher Low): confirmed recovery signal, continuing uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.71x): subdued volume, suggesting potential for slowing upward momentum.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): enter long on resistance breakout, switch to wait-and-see on support breakdown.
